variant: European Watch Company 27756 / source BKM-SS / August 2015 paperwork attribution / 43mm steel, white dial and fitted black rubber deployant
evidence: Original EWC stock 27756 identifies BKM-SS, 43mm steel white-dial world-time/GMT chronograph, black rubber/deployant, numbered 79/500 with papers dated August 2015. Edition/date and BE-54AE specification are dealer attribution, not independent physical calibre/manufacture proof. Eight original 800px files inspected. Actual white dial city ring, three registers, date three, red arrow GMT/chronograph details, KINGSMAN upper-register text and K-symbol lower register; signed crown and additional crown eight. Actual display back bright skeleton rotor signed BREMONT, decorated bright bridges, blue screws and gears, no legible calibre stamp or opened loose movement. BREMONT/CHRONOMETER/WATER RESISTANT 10 ATM rim, seller black-masked identity/edition; do not infer 79/500 from masked pixels. Actual bright signed BREMONT folding clasp on black rubber marked 22-R001. Fitted rubber is the pictured execution, not assumed original film leather. Strap/clasp originality and current performance unproven. Broad Bremont Kingsman source record only representative of this steel/white/rubber specimen; rose-gold KINGSMAN/RG, black-DLC BKM-DLC, ordinary ALT1-WT/ALT1-B and unverified full suffixes do not inherit it. Other family variants remain research gaps. Package frame seven excluded from public gallery receipts; no paperwork used as physical execution proof.
